evidence: FY2026 10-K는 PwC의 무수정 감사의견과 내부통제 유효성 의견을 포함한다.
Q2 FY2027 10-Q는 공시통제·내부통제의 중대한 변경이나 재작성 사항을 보고하지 않았다.
GAAP 순이익에 포함된 대규모 지분증권 평가이익은 별도 공시됐고 회사는 이를 Non-GAAP에서 제외했다.

FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): $23,707M of gain on investments ran through H1 FY2027 net income, against $8,918M for all of FY2026, $1,030M in FY2025 and $238M in FY2024. Of the H1 figure, $12,500M is explicitly disclosed as unrealised marks on publicly held equity securities.

FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): This is why reported net income ($118,010M) exceeds operating income ($117,270M) for H1 FY2027. Roughly 17-20% of reported net income is investment revaluation rather than operations.

INFERENCE, stated as such: this is disclosed, GAAP-compliant treatment under the fair-value rules for equity securities, NOT an integrity failure. The flag is raised because earnings quality is materially affected and because the marked-up assets are stakes in companies whose spending is itself NVIDIA revenue.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Obtain the realised/unrealised split and cost basis of the $47,898M non-marketable portfolio, and confirm that valuation inputs for non-marketable stakes are third-party-led rounds rather than internal marks. Until then, use core earnings excluding investment gains for every valuation test.

evidence: TTM 영업현금흐름은 약 1,344억 달러이고 2026년 7월 말 현금·현금성자산 및 시장성 채무증권은 566억 달러였다.
Q2에 250억 달러 채권을 발행했지만 회사의 영업 생존이 외부자본 조달에 구조적으로 의존한다는 증거는 없다.
다만 일부 AI 클라우드·모델 고객의 인프라 구축은 NVIDIA의 투자·구매약정·신용지원에 의존할 수 있다.
FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): H1 FY2027 operating cash flow $74,421M against capex of $4,434M. FY2026 operating cash flow $102,718M.
FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): Equity $228,984M against total liabilities $91,288M at 2026-07-26.
H1 FY2027 SBC 40억 달러와 주식보상 세금 45억 달러를 398억 달러 자사주 매입이 상쇄했다.
FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): Share count DECLINING through the fastest growth phase in company history: 24,661M (2023-01-29) to 24,100M (2026-08-21), down 2.3%.
FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): SBC $6,386M in FY2026 (3.0% of revenue) against $40,086M of buybacks; $39,044M of buybacks in H1 FY2027 alone.
Q2 Data Center 매출 890억 달러는 전년 동기보다 117% 증가했고 총마진은 75%여서 제품 수요와 경제성은 강하다.
동시에 NVIDIA는 AI 클라우드가 NVIDIA 인프라를 구매하면 360억 달러의 클라우드 서비스를 약정하고, 고객·모델사·금융사에 지분투자하며, 데이터센터 리스와 보증을 제공한다.
AR은 반년 동안 246억 달러 증가했고 Q2 DSO는 전분기 45일에서 60일로 늘어 매출 성장의 독립적 현금회수 품질을 추가 검증해야 한다.
vetoes.resolution_needed: 향후 2~4개 분기의 제3자 AI 클라우드 사용률, 고객별 현금회수, DSO, 약정 감소와 관련 매출을 함께 추적해 판매와 고객지원의 경제적 독립성을 확인한다.
evidence: FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): PRIMARY GATE. NVIDIA is simultaneously supplier to, investor in, and customer of parts of its own demand base. Equity investments held total roughly $90.7B ($42,783M public + $47,898M non-marketable) at 2026-07-26, up from roughly $5B a year earlier, with a further $25B of investment commitments and $29B of committed cloud-service purchases.

FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): Non-marketable equity investments alone went $3,799M (2025-07-27) to $22,251M (2026-01-25) to $47,898M (2026-07-26) - a 12.6x increase in twelve months.

BOUNDING THE RISK, which matters: $25B of investment commitments against roughly $356B of annualised revenue caps the directly vendor-financed slice at well under 10% even on a worst-case 1:1 assumption. The earnings effect is larger and is measured at 17-20% of net income.
COUNTER-EVIDENCE: gross margin of 75.0% in H1 FY2027 is not the signature of bought revenue. Subsidised growth compresses margin; this does not.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Quantify revenue from entities in which NVIDIA holds equity or has investment commitments, as a percentage of total revenue. This is the single most important unresolved question in the file. Until answered, treat reported revenue growth as an upper bound on organic demand growth.

evidence: 과거 증분 영업마진과 FCF 성장은 매우 높지만 H1 FY2027 OCF 744억 달러는 영업이익 1,173억 달러보다 낮았다.
공급 약정은 2026년 1월 952억 달러에서 7월 2,790억 달러로 급증했고, 회사 정의 FCF가 차감하지 않는 지분증권 매입도 H1에 424억 달러였다.
대규모 장기약정의 투자수익률이 아직 관찰되지 않아 높은 과거 ROIC를 미래에 그대로 외삽할 수 없다.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Rubin 전환 이후 공급약정 대비 매출·총이익·현금회수, 재고충당금, 파트너 투자수익을 코호트로 확인한다.

evidence: Blackwell Ultra 확산, 750만 명 이상의 개발자, Q2 Compute & Networking 114% 성장과 75% 총마진은 해자 확장을 지지한다.
자체 ASIC, AMD·Huawei와 수출통제는 위협이지만 현재 공시에는 지속적인 경쟁우위 수축을 입증하는 매출·마진 추세가 없다.

FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): PRIMARY GATE. Total future commitments of $366B at 2026-07-26, of which supply and capacity is $279B - phased $92B in the remainder of FY2027, $87B in FY2028 and $88B in FY2029.

FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): Supply and capacity commitments rose from $95.2B at 2026-01-25 to $279B at 2026-07-26, +193% in six months. The recorded excess-inventory purchase accrual is only $2,138M, so the accounting assumes these commitments will be consumed.

INFERENCE: current incremental ROIC near 100% is computed on a 2.8%-of-revenue capex base. The real capital commitment sits off balance sheet. If demand pauses, that $279B converts from a growth enabler into a write-down and cancellation liability, and incremental ROIC inverts sharply.
FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): Long-term debt $7,469M to $32,366M in six months ($25B notes at 2026-06-30) - the commitments are now partly debt-funded.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Establish the cancellability and repricing terms of the $279B. The FY2026 10-K states these agreements are 'in certain instances' cancellable, reschedulable or adjustable without quantifying which. That quantification determines whether the bear case is a margin event or a balance-sheet event.

evidence: FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): Customer concentration is rising fast, the standard signature of buyer power increasing: Customer One was 13% of Compute & Networking revenue in FY2024, 12% in FY2025, 22% in FY2026. Customer Two reached 14%. Top two at 36% versus 23% a year earlier.
FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): Accounts-receivable concentration at H1 FY2027: 22%, 14%, 13%, 11%, 10% - roughly 70% in five customers.

COUNTER-EVIDENCE, and it is strong: gross margin recovered to 75.0% in H1 FY2027 from 71.1% in FY2026, and networking revenue grew 3.7x in two fiscal years. Pricing power and product scope are both intact today.
INFERENCE: a 75% gross margin is itself the business case for every customer's custom-silicon programme. The moat's success funds its challengers.
vetoes.resolution_needed: Track merchant-GPU versus custom-ASIC share of total accelerator deployments, and whether the top-customer percentage keeps climbing. A third consecutive year of rising concentration alongside any margin erosion would flip this to a material finding.

evidence: 중앙 역산 DCF에서 현재가는 10년 매출 CAGR 약 14.2%~17.1%와 장기 FCF 마진 35%~45%를 요구한다.
요구치는 공격적이나 Q2 매출 106% 성장, Q3 1,080억 달러 가이드와 플랫폼 리더십을 고려하면 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상이라고 단정할 수 없다.
Base 가치 약 221달러가 현재가 227.23달러에 근접한다.

At $226.27 and 24,100M shares, market capitalisation is roughly $5,453B - 23.3x H1 FY2027 annualised diluted EPS of $9.70, or 28.0x core EPS of roughly $8.08 after stripping investment gains and taxing the remainder at the actual 16.5% rate.

INFERENCE: neither multiple requires bull-case-or-better execution. They require the current earnings base to hold and grow modestly. This is the clearest difference between NVDA and most of the AI complex, and it is why this veto reads PASS rather than INVESTIGATE.
The valuation risk sits in the DURATION of the earnings base, which is captured under incremental_roic_collapse, not in the multiple.
Q2 Data Center는 총매출의 약 92.5%였고 H1 FY2027 직접 고객 세 곳이 각각 총매출의 16%, 15%, 13%를 차지했다.
한 AI 연구·배포 회사가 고객의 클라우드 서비스를 통해 의미 있는 간접 수요를 만들었다고 회사가 추정했다.
중국 데이터센터 컴퓨팅은 Q3 가이던스에 포함되지 않아 단일 지역 충격은 현재 숫자에 일부 반영됐지만 제품·고객 집중은 여전히 높다.
vetoes.resolution_needed: 최종 고객·워크로드·지역별 분산, 상위 고객의 CapEx와 신용도, 데이터센터 외 매출 성장의 지속성을 확인한다.

evidence: Bear DCF 가치는 약 92달러로 현재가보다 약 60% 낮아 파산 없이도 큰 영구자본손실이 가능하다.
4,220억 달러 미래약정과 최대 1,085억 달러 보증은 고객수요 둔화나 신용사건 발생 시 하방을 증폭할 수 있다.
강한 현금창출과 순현금·투자자산은 단기 지급불능 가능성을 낮춘다.
vetoes.resolution_needed: 약정·보증 발효 속도와 고객 현금회수의 독립성을 확인하고, Base 가치 대비 충분한 가격 할인 또는 실적 상향이 필요하다.

evidence: FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): PRIMARY GATE. Three concentrations compound. By end market: Data Center is 89.7% of FY2026 revenue. By customer: top two are 36% of Compute & Networking revenue, top five are roughly 70% of receivables. By geography: US is 69.3% of FY2026 revenue, and 76% of Taiwan-billed revenue is to US and European end customers.

FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): China including Hong Kong fell to roughly 7% of revenue in H1 FY2027 from 19.2% in FY2025 - a large market has effectively closed, removing a diversification leg.

INFERENCE from prior harness work: the customers behind that concentration are funding purchases from balance sheet rather than operating cash flow. Hyperscaler 2026 capex is guided above $725B while Alphabet posted its first negative-FCF quarter since 2004 and Meta's cash generation fell 91% YoY. The concentration and the funding fragility are the same exposure.
resolution_needed: Identify the 22% customer and its funding structure. Establish what share of Data Center revenue is to entities whose AI spending is debt- or private-credit-financed rather than internally funded.

evidence: FACT (tier-1, SEC XBRL 10-K FY2026 / 10-Q Q2 FY2027): Equity $228,984M, total assets $320,272M against liabilities $91,288M, H1 operating cash flow $74,421M. No plausible insolvency path.
ESTIMATE (subjective): probability of permanent impairment above 70% is 2-3%. The bear outcome is a severe drawdown, not a loss of capital.
